teaser: Deciding before asking is a quiet habit. You carry life path 1, the number of the one who leads, inside an INFP's instinct to feel out what is right before anything gets moved on. The two don't always agree on timing. You want to act on your own certainty; you also want that certainty to pass a private test of conscience first. That gap is this crossing's weather: a conviction reached alone, then walked out into the world only after it has been measured against something quieter than ambition. The compass is yours. The needle just takes its time settling.
